label: MnCAV full-observer gains solved from the continuous ISS LMI

provenance.noise: lidar: conditional registration error second moments of the first 60 s (2026-10-02 calibration study, reference variance 7.81e-4 m^2 and 4.47e-6 rad^2); gnss: BESTPOS reported sigma median on the 12-09-31 drive; velocity: lateral-velocity RMSE of the adopted MnCAV identification on the evaluation drive (mncavVehicleParameters.json); acceleration and gyro: validation RMSE of the fixed IMU corrections on the 12-11-24 drive (mncavInputCorrections.json); jerk: declared bound above the 0.014 m/s^3 residual of the accelerating-turn maneuver
provenance.errorScales: position in metres; heading weighted by a 10 m landmark range; velocity and acceleration by one second of integration
provenance.scenarios: LiDAR sufficient without GNSS, and LiDAR translational strength 0.05 with GNSS weight at least 0.5 (fixes the GNSS gain)
provenance.decayRate: single design parameter, selected on frames 1-700 of the 12-09-31 drive and checked on frames 701-1169 (research/gain_synthesis_20261011)

route: Continuous seven-state ISS LMI synthesis: minimal ISS radius bound at the declared decay rate; LiDAR-sufficient and weak-translation-with-GNSS scenarios
